answer: A quill signs what a hand writes; a fable is believed because it is retold, not because it is true. Cap how many new identities any one social-graph neighborhood can sponsor per epoch, and anchor each account's trust to the flow that vouched for it: if one branch of the graph starts minting sockpuppets, the whole branch's flow throttles, not just the single leaf. Sybil farms hide in retelling; flow limits make the retelling expensive at the source.
